# CodeCard

> CodeCard helps developers share projects, research, and proof of work through a public profile, link, and QR.

CodeCard is a public-first portfolio product. Visitors can browse published profiles, projects, and research pages without signing in.

## Public pages

- Home: /
- Pricing: /pricing
- How it works: /how-it-works
- Research index: /research
- Public profiles: /{profileSlug}
- Public projects: /{profileSlug}/projects/{projectId}
- Public research: /{profileSlug}/research/{paperSlug}
- Legal: /legal/privacy, /legal/terms, /legal/acceptable-use, /legal/dmca, /legal/subscription, /legal/contact

## Not for indexing

Do not treat these as public product documentation:

- /dashboard/
- /admin/
- /api/
- /auth/
- /sign-in
- /forgot-password
- /reset-password
- /demo/ (preview workspace)

## Contact

- Legal contact: /legal/contact
